Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: faded memories
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind reaches for things and finds them a moment too late. Names slip away. Facts blur. It is not painful, just frustrating, like trying to hold water in cupped hands.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: sleepless dread
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: Sleep comes to {PAWN_nameDef} grudgingly, if at all. The edges of dreams are sharp, and the hours before dawn stretch on forever. {PAWN_pronoun} wakes tired. Always tired.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: weighted steps
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: Every step {PAWN_nameDef} takes costs more than it should. Not pain. Just weight, as if the world itself pushes back a little harder than it does for everyone else.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: cutting tongue
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s words come out with edges now. {PAWN_pronoun} does not always mean it. Sometimes {PAWN_pronoun} does. The troubling part is that {PAWN_pronoun} can no longer tell the difference.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: old pain
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: There is an ache in {PAWN_nameDef} now, settled deep in the bones. It was not there before the Nightwatcher. It will not go away.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: verdant sensitivity
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: Plant-based food turns {PAWN_nameDef}'s stomach now. Not dangerous. Just wrong, in a way that is difficult to describe. The Nightwatcher seemed to find this one amusing.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: grey world
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: The colors are still there. {PAWN_nameDef} can name them, can point to them. But they are muted now, drained of something essential. The world looks like a painting left too long in the rain.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: stranger's face
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: People look at {PAWN_nameDef} differently now. Not with hostility. Something worse. A blankness, as if they can never quite place {PAWN_nameDef}. Conversations die quickly. Friendships struggle to take root.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: sudden stillness
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: It happens without warning. One moment {PAWN_nameDef} is there. The next, {PAWN_pronoun} is gone, pulled under into a dark, dreamless nothing. {PAWN_pronoun} wakes moments later, disoriented, on the ground.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: compelled hand
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: One task calls to {PAWN_nameDef} above all others. {PAWN_pronoun} cannot say why. {PAWN_pronoun} simply finds {PAWN_possessive} hands doing it, again and again, while other work goes undone.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: watcher's shadow
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: Something watches {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} feels it at the edge of {PAWN_possessive} vision, in the silence between sounds. It never speaks. It never leaves. {PAWN_pronoun} knows it is there the way {PAWN_pronoun} knows the ground is beneath {PAWN_possessive} feet.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: glass bones
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s bones are fragile now, though they look the same. A fall that should bruise instead fractures. A blow that others endure becomes something far worse for {PAWN_nameDef}.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: severed heart
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: Something warm has gone quiet inside {PAWN_nameDef}. Not dead. Just distant. {PAWN_pronoun} can form relationships, can go through the motions. But they never quite take root the way they should.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: lost name
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: Who {PAWN_nameDef} was before is gone. The skills, the knowledge, the careful craft of years, all wiped clean. {PAWN_pronoun} starts again from nothing, frightened and disoriented. The Nightwatcher was not being cruel. She simply did not understand what she was taking.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: silenced
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s voice still works. The sounds come out fine. But the meaning does not carry. {PAWN_pronoun} has been silenced in a way that bypasses the throat entirely, as if the Nightwatcher reached in and severed something between thought and speech.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.label: spirit web scarring
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherCu.description: The Nightwatcher's gift came with a price woven into {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web. One of {PAWN_possessive} powers has been pushed far beyond safe limits - the Investiture has been carved so deeply into {PAWN_possessive} soul that it can never be removed. The power is undeniable, but so is the cost.
